content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons earlier removed from any post for indiscipline, improper behaviour, arbitrariness or irregularity by Chhattisgarh Ajeevika Samvardhan Samiti or any government department Applicant who married before the minimum legal age of marriage Person married to someone with a living spouse, unless the Government grants exemption Candidate with more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 26 January 2001

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment for one year and wholly temporary Extension by one year may be considered on work ability, efficiency, annual evaluation and behaviour, with consent of both sides Either side may end the contract with one month's notice or one month's pay No pension, gratuity or death benefit (except compassionate grant) for contract service Governed by Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application (5:30)

content_sections.heading: How Will Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list based on marks: 70 for marks in minimum educational qualification, 15 for experience, 15 for one-year diploma/certificate or Panchayat-cum-DEO experience Provisional list displayed on Janpad Panchayat notice board for claims and objections 70 marks: weightage of marks obtained in minimum educational qualification 15 marks: experience in government rural development schemes on at least equal honorarium - 5 marks for 6 months, 1 mark per further 6 months, maximum 15 Equal marks: the older candidate is selected first If no eligible applicant from a gram panchayat, a same-category candidate from the same Janpad Panchayat is selected on merit

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all certificates and mark sheets Permanent caste certificate issued by competent authority (SC/ST/OBC) Chhattisgarh residence certificate issued by competent authority District Medical Board certificate for applicants with disability Verified copy of experience certificate with outward number issued by employer No Objection Certificate from employer for government or semi-government employees

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: See the application form format on the Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam notice board during office hours or at www.bijapur.gov.in. Fill the form completely, naming the gram panchayat applied for. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates and mark sheets. Employees of government institutions apply through proper channel with a No Objection Certificate. Submit in person during office hours or by post at the office of Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam before 30/11/2026, 5:30.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the fixed date and time will not be considered Applications without self-attested documents will not be accepted Number of posts is variable Final decision on any dispute rests with the District Collector

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies: 1 Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Angampalli), 1 Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Badekakaled), 1 Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Sandra), 1 Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Edapalli), 1 Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Kerpe), 1 Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Dammur) and 8 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Pages 4-5 of this PDF; also on the Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam notice board or www.bijapur.gov.in) and send it to Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat Bhopalpatnam, District Bijapur (C.G.), by in person or by post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and less than 35 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: All categories Maximum age relaxation as per orders/instructions issued from time to time by the General Administration Department, Government of Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 9960 for Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Angampalli), 9960 for Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Badekakaled), 9960 for Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Sandra), 9960 for Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Edapalli), 9960 for Gram Rozgar Sahayak (Kerpe).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th pass (10th pass for ST and SC) and resident of the concerned gram panchayat; for Bastar and Surguja divisions the priority order is 12th pass, 10th pass, 8th pass. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Experience accepted only from government rural development schemes on posts of at least equal pay scale.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons earlier removed from any post for indiscipline, improper behaviour, arbitrariness or irregularity by Chhattisgarh Ajeevika Samvardhan Samiti or any government department. Applicant who married before the minimum legal age of marriage. Person married to someone with a living spouse, unless the Government grants exemption. Candidate with more than two living children, one of whom was born on or after 26 January 2001.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list based on marks: 70 for marks in minimum educational qualification, 15 for experience, 15 for one-year diploma/certificate or Panchayat-cum-DEO experience. Provisional list displayed on Janpad Panchayat notice board for claims and objections. 70 marks: weightage of marks obtained in minimum educational qualification. 15 marks: experience in government rural development schemes on at least equal honorarium - 5 marks for 6 months, 1 mark per further 6 months, maximum 15.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment for one year and wholly temporary. Extension by one year may be considered on work ability, efficiency, annual evaluation and behaviour, with consent of both sides. Either side may end the contract with one month's notice or one month's pay.
